title: Software Engineer II - Edge
description:
**About NCR VOYIX**
NCR Voyix Corporation (NYSE: VYX) is a global platform-powered leader in unified commerce for shopping and dining. Combining a flexible, intelligent platform with end-to-end payments capabilities and services developed through its deep industry experience, NCR Voyix empowers retailers and restaurants to accelerate new possibilities for their operations, experiences and business outcomes. NCR Voyix is headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia, and serves customers in more than 35 countries worldwide.
  
  

* Title: Software Engineer (II)

**Location:**
Hyderabad
  
  
**Experience:**
3 – 7 years
  
  
**About Us:**
NCR Voyix Corporation (NYSE: VYX) is a global technology company leading how the world connects, interacts, and transacts with business. Our assisted and self-service solutions and comprehensive support services address the needs of hospitality and retail sectors in more than 40+ countries.
  
  
**Role Overview:**
Join our market-leading, innovative Edge platform team at NCR Voyix. We are dedicated to pushing the boundaries of technology and delivering top-notch solutions to our customers. As a Software Engineer II, you will be an integral part of our EDGE team, tackling complex development tasks and performing code reviews. You will also assist in defining stories on the backlog, participate in design activities, and collaborate with QA and internal stakeholders to ensure the delivery of high-quality solutions.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Take on complex development tasks within the team.
* Perform code reviews to maintain code quality.
* Participate in design activities.
* Liaise with QA and internal stakeholders to ensure the right solution and quality.
* Core Skills
* Strong development skills: Emphasize clean code, agile methodologies, and SOLID principles. Strong experience in designing software solutions and conducting thorough code reviews.
* Proficiency in Go: Extensive experience in developing high-performance applications using Golang. Familiarity with Go's concurrency model, goroutines, and channels. Ability to write efficient, scalable, and maintainable code.
* GIT: Strong experience with version control systems, particularly Git.
* Multi-threaded development: Experience in designing and implementing multi-threaded applications.
* Linux OS: Proficiency in working with Linux operating systems, understanding of networking concepts and protocols within a Linux environment. Proficiency in Bash scripting, installation, boot process, and building/configuring the kernel and modules.
* Cloud computing: Exposure to cloud platforms, ideally Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
* Containerization: Experience with Docker and Kubernetes for containerization and orchestration. Ability to design, deploy, and manage containerized applications. Familiarity with Kubernetes architecture, components, and best practices for scaling and maintaining clusters.
* Additional technologies: Familiarity with Service Mesh principles, CouchDB, OTEL, Grafana, GCP cloud logging, Fluentd, GitHub/GitHub Actions, and Helm. Experience with KCC, Kubeadm, and GraphQL is nice to have.
* Basic Qualifications
* Degree in a numerate discipline.
* Excellent programming skills in one or more modern languages, preferably Go.
* Strong grounding in Computer Science.

Offers of employment are conditional upon passage of screening criteria applicable to the job

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, age, race, color, creed, religion, national origin, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, military service, genetic information, or any other characteristic or conduct protected by law. title: Software Engineer (React Native)
description:
**Company Description**
Acrapath is a hiring platform, recruitment agency, and technology agency headquartered in Kirti Nagar, Delhi, supporting jobseekers and employers across India and globally. The platform brings together direct employer job postings and roles sourced from company career pages, supported by AI-powered job matching and personalized job recommendations. Jobseekers benefit from tailored alerts, career guidance from Acra, an AI assistant, and enhanced visibility through verified profiles and the Talbox candidate directory. Employers can post jobs, search a growing database of candidate profiles, and leverage end-to-end recruitment services, from sourcing to interview coordination. As a technology agency, Acrapath also builds digital solutions informed by its experience creating AI-driven recruitment tools, helping businesses hire faster and work smarter.

**Role Description**
This is a full-time, on-site Software Engineer (React Native) role based in Delhi, India. The Software Engineer will design, develop, and maintain mobile applications using React Native, ensuring high performance, scalability, and reliability. Daily responsibilities include writing clean, maintainable code, integrating front-end interfaces with back-end services, and collaborating with product managers, designers, and other engineers to deliver new features. The role involves debugging and optimizing existing applications, participating in code reviews, and contributing to technical documentation and best practices. The Software Engineer will also help improve development workflows, stay current with mobile and JavaScript ecosystem trends, and support the continuous enhancement of Acrapath’s digital products.

**Qualifications**

* Strong foundation in Computer Science, including data structures, algorithms, and software design principles.
* Proficiency in Software Development and Programming, with hands-on experience building production applications.
* Experience with Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) and applying OOP concepts to structure and maintain complex codebases.
* Understanding of Back-End Web Development concepts and ability to integrate React Native apps with APIs and server-side services.
* Practical experience with React Native, JavaScript/TypeScript, mobile UI frameworks, and RESTful API integration.
* Familiarity with version control (e.g., Git), automated testing, and CI/CD pipelines for mobile applications.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Ability to work collaboratively in a cross-functional team, communicate clearly, and take ownership of deliverables.
* Experience in building scalable consumer or enterprise mobile apps and interest in recruitment or HR tech is an advantage.
